firm_data.firm_description: Phillips & Associates is a workplace discrimination law firm serving the New York City and Tri-State area. The firm represents clients who have been sexually harassed or discriminated against because of their race, national origin, gender, religion, disability and other protected traits.
notable_facts: Has recovered more than $300 million for employees.
Firm has handled more than 8,000 employment matters and litigated nearly 2,000 cases.
Selected as one of the “10 Best Employment & Labor Law Firms in New York” by the American Institute of Legal Counsel.

email.subject: AI for Phillips & Associates, built for employment law firms
email.body:
Hi Vanessa,

Phillips & Associates has recovered over $300 million for employees facing discrimination and harassment. That track record speaks to your team's skill, but I imagine case volume and document complexity make operations increasingly demanding.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms managing BigLaw-scale work with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what smaller practices actually need: precision, client trust, and efficiency without bloat.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms to share how ex-lawyers like us are helping practices compete effectively. I'd be happy to stop by your office on Thursday, April 10 to show how we're supporting employment and discrimination law practices like yours.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
